The Cal-Adapt: Analytics Engine website has a new look! 

What’s new:

- A cleaner, more organized layout for guidance and documentation
- A new Blog section to keep you posted on updates like this one
- Reorganized navigation across scientific guidance, data & tools, and general resources

Please update any bookmarks, saved links, or citations to point to the new site. Deep links to specific guidance pages will redirect automatically where possible, but if you maintain a citation or reference list, we recommend updating links to the new site

Data access, the Analytics Engine JupyterHub, and climakitae workflows are unaffected. This is a website update only. 

Take a look around and let us know what you think at analytics@cal-adapt.org!
